summary: Verified P0 fixes for user-reported issues: EMERGENCY reset/resume, Telegram START_BOT, BybitClient throttling, cautious config defaults, portfolio_tp disabled, basket profit guard with 20% drawdown, manual position TP preservation. All 79 tests pass (16 backend_test.py + 63 pytest).
passed_tests: RiskGuard reset clears consecutive losses counter
Telegram START_BOT clears emergency and resumes guard
Config portfolio_tp.enabled is false by default
basket_profit_guard closes all positions on drawdown with negative position
basket_profit_guard does NOT close without negative position
basket_profit_state resets when all positions closed
critical_code_review_comments: Code correctly implements EMERGENCY reset in both reset_guard() and resume() methods
BybitClient has proper request throttling with _request_lock and configurable intervals
BybitClient _request has retry logic with exponential backoff on rate-limit errors (code 10006)
Telegram START_BOT handler properly calls controls._guard.resume() to clear emergency
basket_profit_guard correctly checks require_negative_position before closing basket
Manual positions correctly set external_tp_locked=True when take_profit is set on exchange
ExitEngine.check_exit properly respects allow_early_exit parameter for manual positions
portfolio_tp correctly requires position_manager.count() >= 2 before triggering

context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 fixes verified working: (1) RiskGuard.reset_guard() and resume() clear EMERGENCY state allowing trading to resume, (2) Telegram START_BOT calls guard.resume(), (3) BybitClient has rate limiting via _request_lock and retries with backoff, (4) Config tuned with transformer_threshold=0.60 and cautious but active defaults, (5) portfolio_tp disabled by default and requires >=2 positions, (6) basket_profit_guard closes at 20% drawdown from peak when one position is negative, (7) manual positions skip early_exit and preserve existing TP via external_tp_locked flag. No live network testing was performed per instructions - code-level logic only.
rca_of_issue: User reported (1) bot not trading - caused by EMERGENCY state not being cleared properly, now fixed via reset_guard()/resume() clearing the status, (2) positions closing early - manual positions now skip early_exit by passing allow_early_exit=False to check_exit(), and preserve existing TP via external_tp_locked flag
